summary: This Form 8-K reports the closing of JATT II Acquisition Corp's initial public offering of 6,000,000 ordinary shares at $10.00 per share, generating $60 million in gross proceeds, plus a simultaneous private placement of 300,000 shares at $10.00 per share to JATT Ventures II L.P. for $3 million. The net proceeds ($60 million) were deposited in a trust account for public shareholders. This is a routine capital-raising event for a blank-check company, not a special situation. No business combination, tender offer, or other special event is disclosed.
